title: Στίχοι περὶ ζῴων ἰδιότητος, De animalium proprietate (On the Properties of Animals)
author: Manuel Philes
date: early 14th c. CE (dedicated to Michael IX Palaiologos)
edition: Lehrs & Dübner, Poetae bucolici et didactici (Didot 1851/1862; Greek with Latin), public domain.
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia 'Мануил Фил' lists no translations; none found.
en_evidence: No English translation found (English Wikipedia, Crossref).
other_translations: None modern found (only the 19th-c. Latin version)
value: A Byzantine verse reworking of Aelian and Oppian: a case study in how ancient natural history was passed on. Completes a 'zoological poetry' series with Oppian and Nicander. Truly untranslated.
ai_feasibility: High. Simple dodecasyllables, and aligning with the Aelian sources can be automated.
pilot_unit: Opening about 500 verses, aligned with Aelian
